index_stay: MIMIC: first ICU intime per subject_id; eICU: minimum unitvisitnumber, then patientunitstayid per uniquepid; cross-admission chronology uncertain
risk_set: adult age >=18, still alive and in ICU at each strict prediction cutoff; ICU outtime or unitdischargeoffset must exceed cutoff
death_time: MIMIC admissions.deathtime exact timestamp; patients.dod is date-only and cannot set ICU death hour; eICU unit and hospital discharge status with discharge offsets

input_availability.mimic_chart_and_lab: measurement charttime >= ICU admission and max(charttime,storetime) < cutoff; missing storetime excluded
input_availability.mimic_input_and_procedure: starttime >= ICU admission and storetime < cutoff
input_availability.mimic_prescriptions: prescriptions.starttime and linked poe.ordertime both < cutoff; missing POE link excluded
input_availability.eicu_vitals: observationoffset in [0,cutoff); no separate entry timestamp in source
input_availability.eicu_medication: drugorderoffset and drugstartoffset both before cutoff

endpoints.icu_mortality: ICU death after cutoff and on or before ICU outtime; exact deathtime required in MIMIC
endpoints.inhosp_mortality: hospital death after cutoff and before hospital discharge; exact MIMIC deathtime or eICU discharge status/offset
endpoints.aki: creatinine rise >=0.3 mg/dL or >=1.5x last available pre-cutoff creatinine within next 48h; no qualifying follow-up -> unknown
endpoints.sepsis_deterioration: operational Deterioration: GCS drop >=3 or MAP crossing from median >=70 to min <65 in next 24h (MIMIC); eICU MAP-only exploratory
endpoints.escalation: new vasopressor or invasive ventilation indicator within next 24h; incomplete negative follow-up -> unknown

split.legacy: preserve deterministic 70/10/20 assignment among original cohort; new patient SHA256(version|seed|ID) quantiles 0.7/0.8

bootstrap_unit: patient; matched analysis samples pairs; hospital summary samples hospitals
